candidates.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
candidates.summary: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

candidates.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
candidates.summary: AWS Quick now has a Meta ads AI connector. Meta advertisers can use natural language in Quick to create, manage, and analyze campaigns while staying connected to the Meta ad management network, and combine Meta ad data with first- and third-party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows.
